text: Why is LoRaWAN's duty-cycle regulation a hard design constraint?
choices: It limits the number of gateways
In Europe a device may transmit only 1% of the time in the 868 MHz band, which bounds how much any device can ever say
explanation: The constraint is regulatory rather than technical and it shapes application design: a sensor cannot simply increase its reporting rate when something interesting happens. NB-IoT, in licensed spectrum, has no such limit but requires a subscription.
